rules.name: Swahili Universal Syllogism (Ikiwa Wanadamu)
rules.description: Kiswahili formal logic syllogism: Wanadamu wote ni viumbe wenye busara. John ni mwanadamu -> John ni kiumbe mwenye busara.
premises: Ikiwa wanadamu wote ni viumbe wenye busara
rules.lean4Notation: example (Mwanadamu MwenyeBusara : Mtu → Prop) (h1 : ∀ x, Mwanadamu x → MwenyeBusara x) (h2 : Mwanadamu John) : MwenyeBusara John := h1 John h2

rules.name: Universal Syllogism (Human-Rational)
rules.description: Aristotelian Syllogism: All humans are rational beings. John is human -> John is rational.
rules.lean4Notation: example (Human Rational : Entity → Prop) (h1 : ∀ x, Human x → Rational x) (h2 : Human John) : Rational John := h1 Human h2

rules.name: Turkish Universal Syllogism (Bütün İnsanlar)
rules.description: Türkçe Aristoteles Tasımı: Bütün insanlar akıllıdır. John bir insandır -> John akıllıdır.
rules.lean4Notation: example (Insan Akilli : Varlik → Prop) (h1 : ∀ x, Insan x → Akilli x) (h2 : Insan John) : Akilli John := h1 John h2

rules.name: Classical Modus Ponens
rules.description: If P then Q; P is true -> Q is true.
rules.smtFormula: (declare-const P Bool) (declare-const Q Bool) (assert (=> P Q)) (assert P) (check-sat)
rules.lean4Notation: theorem modus_ponens (P Q : Prop) (hpq : P → Q) (hp : P) : Q := hpq hp

rules.name: First Law of Thermodynamics
rules.description: dU = dQ - dW (Energy conservation in closed thermodynamic systems)
rules.lean4Notation: axiom first_law_of_thermodynamics (dU dQ dW : Real) : dU = dQ - dW

rules.name: Shannon Channel Capacity Bound
rules.description: C = B * log2(1 + S/N) (Maximum error-free information transmission rate)
rules.lean4Notation: axiom shannon_capacity (R B S N : Real) : R ≤ B * Real.logb 2 (1 + S / N)

rules.name: ISO 26262 ASIL-D Memory Guard
rules.description: Memory writes must strictly stay within allocated process boundary addresses
rules.lean4Notation: theorem iso26262_mem_guard (target size start_b end_b : Nat) (h1 : target ≥ start_b) (h2 : target + size ≤ end_b) : True := trivial
